title: Traffic Construction Signs
description: Use this service request to report a problem with signage, signs, or cones of ongoing construction on City of Dallas streets. (Ex. - signs that may be missing, moved or knocked over or signs that were left at a construction site once work has been completed.) The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about misplaced, missing, damaged, or leftover construction signs.
actions.why: For a sign, cone, or construction warning on a City street that is missing, damaged, moved, in the wrong location, or left after work was completed. The 311 request form asks what happened, when it was noticed, and the nearest intersection or cross street.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Construction Signs"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Construction Signs"
